verdict.rationale: Apify publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (confirmed by probe) and an API v2 reference section, and its JS and Python client docs include copy-paste code examples for running Actors and retrieving results. Nothing shows the reference is interactive, such as an in-browser try-it console that executes requests. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it/runnable console in the API reference, examples runnable directly from the reference pages, independent or hands-on corroboration.
